standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.npc: You saved us! Huzzah!

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.player: All in a day's work, think nothing of it.

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.npc: I don't have anything to reward you with except my collection of bleak, gothic poetry I wrote when I assumed we were all done for. Do you want it?

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.player: I may come for it later, you hang on to it for now.

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.npc: I don't know what your game is, but I know you're one of THEM!
The voices tell me different. It's all part of a plot! Confess!
Have they gone yet?

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.player: Well, no, but they are a lot calmer now.

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.npc: What are we gonna do now, huh? What are we gunna do now?

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.player: In your case I would say relax.

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.npc: Well you proved that you're probably not a zombie.
So what are you then? A ghoul? A vampyre?

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.player: I'm not any form of undead!

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.npc: Oh...oh god I'm sorry, I didn't realise it was natural...
Nothing...
Hello there, brave hero, in whom I had total confidence!
Yes! I was so confident that I would never, ever have sold your soft, edible body to the pirates outside!
On a completely unrelated note, I would steer clear of Hungry Frank for a while.
He's a filthy liar. And a forger. It wouldn't surprise me if he has written out a note detailing the terms of our surrender and your dismemberment and cooking in MY handwriting.
Imagine that, the fiend.
My brain is no longer capable of sleep.

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.player: So...what are you going to do now?

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.npc: I was gonna try and will myself dead.
Hello yerself Landlubber!
Hmmm...Overall everything is good!
Hello yourself!
Fine...

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.player: Excellent! Since I get the feeling I don't want to know why you said that so oddly I'll just go over here!

standard-dialogue-after-rum-deal-brewer-.npc: I think that would be for the best!
